cim: Oracle Academy sponsors “ManiGreen” conference for Italian educators, hosted by the University of Arkansas Rome, with a focus on AI
cim_eredeti: Oracle Academy sponsors “ManiGreen” conference for Italian educators, hosted by the University of Arkansas Rome, with a focus on AI
szoveg_eredeti:
The “ManiGreen” 2026 conference for Italian educators took place October 12, 2026, at the historic Palazzo Taverna, home to the University of Arkansas Rome Center in Rome, Italy. The event explored how art, artificial intelligence, and education can encourage creativity, ethical responsibility, and a more sustainable future. Discussions focused on AI’s effects on human creativity and the role of innovation in making cities and businesses more environmentally sustainable.

The discussion opened with Mario De Caro, Professor of Moral Philosophy at Roma Tre University and co-holder, together with Benedetta Giovanola, UNESCO Chair in Ethics of AI and Practical Wisdom. His contribution focused on the human qualities that deserve greater attention as artificial intelligence takes on increasingly complex tasks.

Stefano Dello Strologo, Oracle Database Platform Sales Representative, shared a practical example of how algorithms are already influencing music production and the management of sound at live concerts. Miriam Mirolla, art historian and professor at the Academy of Fine Arts in Rome, shifted the conversation towards creativity as a way of understanding what is truly worth doing in a world increasingly shaped by technology.

Angelica Bianco, from the Italian Parliamentary Intergroup on Artificial Intelligence, spoke about authenticity, sensitivity and the aspects of human experience that technology cannot replace. The event concluded with Maria Laura Sadolfo, psychologist and Lazio regional representative of the Italian Mindfulness Federation, who brought the discussion back to a topic of our attention and the quality of it.

Oracle Academy was represented by Roberta Battagli, Oracle Academy Program Manager for Italy, who explained to Italian educators the benefits of the free Oracle Academy Program offering from Oracle, an AI leader.

Oracle Academy enables teachers to make technology accessible and inspiring for all students and guide them in acquiring skills required by today’s and tomorrow’s job market — cloud, artificial intelligence, data science, the Internet of Things, and more.

The resources available include Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, Oracle APEX, Oracle NetSuite, Oracle Primavera, a wide range of software, career pathways, and ongoing training opportunities, often recognized with CPD credits. Teachers, through the Oracle Academy Member Hub platform, can easily access materials, support, training events, and consulting sessions.

Not a member? Join now. Learn more at academy.oracle.com.
